entry_activation_level.label: Re-entry band reacceptance
entry_activation_level.reason: After a pullback, reacceptance back above the floor of the 2026.18-2030.79 AVWAP/value re-entry band confirms the reclaim is holding instead of rejecting.

entry_zone.label: Retest of reclaimed value edge
entry_zone.reason: This zone aligns the current session VAH near 2025.66 with the floor of the first re-entry band at 2026.18, giving the best non-chase location for the repair path.

entry_invalidation_level.label: Pullback failure back into prior value
entry_invalidation_level.reason: Acceptance back below 2025.01 and especially under 2024.49 means the reclaimed band failed and price is slipping back into prior value rather than building above it.
